overview_description.description: Fruitful Day is a Dubai-based food and wellness company founded in 2015 that specializes in delivering fresh, high-quality fruit and healthy snacks directly to homes and offices. The company operates on a subscription-based model, allowing customers to receive curated seasonal fruit boxes on a regular basis without long-term commitments. Focused on promoting healthier lifestyles, Fruitful Day partners with local and regional farmers to source fresh produce, which is hand-picked, prepared, and delivered through its certified facilities. The platform also offers a variety of services including corporate fruit deliveries, gifting solutions, event catering, and fruit-based platters and desserts.

about_short_description.short_description: Fruitful Day is a supplier of fruits for the workplace and homes.

product.name: Subscription for Homes & Offices
product.description: Regular delivery of seasonal fruit boxes to homes or workplaces without contracts, allowing skip or cancellation anytime.

product.name: Corporate Solutions
product.description: Customized fruit delivery and healthy eating solutions tailored for workplaces to promote employee wellness.

product.name: Fresh Fruit Platters
product.description: Prepared fruit platters of various sizes for gatherings and events, made fresh to order.

product.name: Fruit Boxes and Bowls
product.description: Boxes and bowls containing selected fresh fruits, available in various sizes and assortments for individual or group consumption.

product.name: Cakes and Character Cakes
product.description: Fruit-based cakes and themed character cakes made with fresh fruit for celebrations and special occasions.

product.name: Juices and Artisan Ice Pops
product.description: Bottled fresh juices and handcrafted ice pops made from natural fruit ingredients, available in packs.
